maddeler.e:
اشتعلوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلُوا (ištaʕalū) /iʃ.ta.ʕa.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلُوا (uštuʕilū) /uʃ.tu.ʕi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعِلُوا (ištaʕilū) /iʃ.ta.ʕi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
